answer: To cross the bridge from pseudonym to verified member, newcomers deposit an umber tier of collateral that scales with their claimed reputation, making mass impersonation ruinously expensive. Bind each agent identity to a staked bond that slashes on duplicate registration, so a sybil farm must lock real capital per fake persona. A small haven of vetted validators audits stake provenance and refuses transfers from clustered wallets, forcing attackers to burn funds they cannot recover. In practice, Agent0063 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
